Maria (CS): Heads up — Peregrine is showing a steady spike in p95 latency and token costs after we enabled long-context for their summarization flow. Renewal in 6 weeks, want to preempt.

Ashley (Solutions): Can you paste the dashboard link? I can run a quick simulation for quantized model.

Maria (CS): https://redwood.console/tenant/peregrine/perf-dashboard :eyes:
Metric snapshot from last 48h: p50 120ms -> 150ms, p95 420ms -> 680ms, tokens/day +38%.

Dhruv (ML): Looks like KV cache miss rate increased with longer prefixes. Two low-risk options: 1) int8 quantized variant of their current model (fast path on C2 nodes) 2) swap to the 70B distilled variant for chat summarization. Both reduce cost. Can run canary.

Jordan (PS): Would prefer quantization first — fewer behavioral change risks. Any evals on hallucination/regression?

Dhruv (ML): Ran a 200-sample prompt set last night. Diff is tiny (<1% ROUGE drop) and latency improved ~35% on C2. I can share the eval CSV.

Ashley (Solutions): If we go quantize+route, propose routing policy: primary -> quantized (region A), fallback -> full-precision (region B). Canary 5% for 48h.

Maria (CS): Also want to make this visible to Peregrine pre-renewal. Need a short one-pager stating impact on latency/cost and the rollback plan.

Theo (AE): I'll loop Peregrine's CTO in. Low-risk approach helps renewal conversation.

Dhruv (ML): Quick config snippet for canary routing:
```json
{
  "routing": [
    {"percentage": 95, "model": "peregrine-summ-v1-int8", "region": "us-east-1"},
    {"percentage": 5, "model": "peregrine-summ-v1-fp16", "region": "us-west-2"}
  ],
  "canary_duration": "48h",
  "monitoring": ["latency.p95", "gen_quality.rouge"]
}
```

Maria (CS): Perfect. Dhruv, can you push the canary by EOD? Ashley, can you draft the one-pager? Theo, please wait to email until canary is healthy.

DeployBot: canary-deploy started for peregrine-summ-v1-int8 at 2165432190 :rocket:

Ashley (Solutions): On it — will have a 1-page PDF and a short slide for the renewal call.

Dhruv (ML): Canary metrics 2h in: p95 down 32%, cost/req down 27%, rouge diff 0.9%. Pushing full 5% now.

Maria (CS): Awesome. Marking as action items: Dhruv -> finish canary, Ashley -> one-pager, Theo -> hold outreach. I'll update account health score.

Jordan (PS): Add a follow-up in two weeks to check regression alerts and usage delta.

Theo (AE): +1

Maria (CS): :thumbsup: Closing thread when canary completes and assets uploaded.
